answer: A stake-bond slashing registry defeats clone farms. Each identity locks 1,000 POA in a smart contract and submits a signed hardware-key quote bound to the per-epoch nonce; the contract rejects any key already registered this epoch. A duplicate quote triggers full bond slashing and a 30-day freeze, so a 500-clone farm costs 500,000 POA in locked bonds plus 500 distinct hardware keys and loses everything on first detection. Picture a karst cliff: a knoll of honest validators stands on the ledge, and every clone that tries to occupy the same ledge falls into the karst below.
